title: Prediction Error
description: EEG and motion-capture dataset from 19 participants performing a haptic interaction task in virtual reality, in which participants touched virtual objects while visual, vibrotactile, and electrical muscle stimulation feedback was varied. Some trials were designed as oddball conflicts to elicit prediction error responses. The recordings support research on the neural correlates of prediction errors and on detecting unrealistic interactions in cyber-physical systems.
methods_description: 63-channel EEG was recorded with a Brain Products BrainAmp DC amplifier and an EasyCap actiCap 64ch cap (reference FCz, ground AFz), plus one EOG channel. HTC Vive head and right-hand motion capture was recorded at 90 Hz. Stimulation was delivered in three blocks combining visual, vibrotactile, and EMS feedback, with normal versus conflict (oddball) trials.
